fill.summaryAnswer:
— We watched the 2000s trilogy three evenings running and argued about the scariest villain.
— Lisa fell asleep halfway through the second film and demanded the whole plot at breakfast.
— Alex climbed the hallway wall and brought down the coat rack: the suit was a bedsheet.
— On the last evening everyone picked their own: three of us agreed, Dad held his ground.
